title: የመጨረሻው ምዕራፍ (The Final Chapter)
style_block: Cinematic realistic digital painting, warm amber lamp light at night, soft golden morning light, muted earth tones, Ethiopian home and school, gentle film grain, natural faces and hands

characters.description: An 18-year-old Ethiopian young man with short black hair, warm dark eyes, wearing a simple button-up shirt
A 50-year-old Ethiopian man with gentle eyes and graying hair, draped in a traditional white woven cotton gabi

voice.style: calm, warm and serious, like a father speaking softly at night

cues.caption: Gentle acoustic krar and soft ambient pads building from contemplative to hopeful tone

music.choice_reason: Reflective and warm traditional acoustic string melody creating emotional depth.

shots.purpose: Establish the quiet atmosphere of the home at night where the journey begins.

keyframe.prompt: Night view of a small modest Ethiopian stone home in a quiet neighborhood, one small window lit with warm amber light from inside, peaceful dark blue night sky, centred composition

motion.prompt: Slow forward zoom toward the glowing warm window of the house at night.

narration.text: ጸጥ ባለው ሌሊት፣ ከአንድ ትንሽ ቤት መስኮት ሞቅ ያለ ብርሃን ይወጣል።
narration.subtitle: On a quiet night, warm light shines from the window of a small house.

shots.purpose: Introduce the father delivering the pivotal warning to his child.

keyframe.prompt: Interior of a simple wooden bedroom at night, a middle-aged Ethiopian father in a traditional white gabi standing softly framed in the doorway looking at a young Ethiopian student seated at a wooden desk, amber lamp light, centred composition

motion.prompt: Slow tilt up from the study table to the man standing in the doorway speaking gently.

narration.text: አባቴ በበሩ ቆሞ እንዲህ አለኝ፤ ፈተና ቀልድ አያውቅም፤ ውጤትም ይቅርታ የለውም።
narration.subtitle: My father stood in the doorway and said: an exam knows no jokes, and the result knows no forgiveness.

shots.purpose: Show the past wasted opportunity and casual attitude toward studying.

keyframe.prompt: Memory scene with warm soft lighting, a young Ethiopian student sitting outdoors on a wooden bench laughing with friends, a closed thick textbook sitting neglected beside him, soft golden backlight, centred composition

motion.prompt: Gentle pan across the seated figures in warm outdoor light.

narration.text: በፊት ከጓደኞቼ ጋር እየሳቅሁ መጽሐፌን ዘግቼ እተወው ነበር።
narration.subtitle: Before, I used to laugh with friends and leave my book closed.

shots.purpose: Highlight the unused tools and initial procrastination.

keyframe.prompt: Extreme close-up of a small wooden study desk under amber oil lamp light, featuring a closed thick book and a long, untouched wooden pencil beside it, centred composition

motion.prompt: Slow camera push-in toward the wooden table under amber glow.

narration.text: አዲሱ እርሳስ አልተቀረጸም፤ ጊዜው ግን እየሄደ ነበር።
narration.subtitle: The new pencil remained untouched, but time was slipping away.

shots.purpose: Show the turn towards serious late-night preparation.

keyframe.prompt: Medium shot of a young Ethiopian male student leaning over a wooden study desk at night, reading attentively under the warm glow of a desk lamp, serious focused expression, centred composition

motion.prompt: Slow push-in on the seated person turning a book page under warm light.

narration.text: የአባቴ ቃላት በጆሮዬ ሲያቃጭሉ፣ የጠረጴዛውን መብራት አብርቼ በየሌሊቱ ማጥናት ጀመርኩ።
narration.subtitle: With my father's words ringing in my ears, I lit the lamp and began studying every night.

shots.purpose: Symbolize the dedication and passage of time through the worn pencil.

keyframe.prompt: Close-up of a wooden desk surface at night, featuring a short, heavily worn pencil stub lying next to filled open notebook pages under warm lamp light, centred composition

motion.prompt: Slow downward camera pan focusing on the table surface and short pencil.

narration.text: ሌሊቶች አለፉ፤ እርሳሱ እያጠረ፣ ደብተሩም እየሞላ ሄደ።
narration.subtitle: Nights passed; the pencil grew shorter, and the notebook filled up.

shots.purpose: Show confidence and calm preparedness on exam morning.

keyframe.prompt: Wide outdoor morning scene, a young Ethiopian student walking calmly toward a large brick school hall, soft golden morning sunlight, out-of-focus background figures, centred composition

motion.prompt: Slow camera tracking shot following the walking figure toward the distant building.

narration.text: በማለዳ ጸሐይ፣ ተረጋግቼና ተዘጋጅቼ ወደ ፈተናው አዳራሽ አመራሁ።
narration.subtitle: In the morning sun, calm and ready, I walked toward the exam hall.

shots.purpose: Deliver the climax of success and the father's second proverb.

keyframe.prompt: Medium shot at the doorway of a home in soft daylight, a proud Ethiopian father wearing a white gabi embracing his young adult son warmly with genuine relief and joy, centred composition

motion.prompt: Slow push-in toward the embrace near the illuminated doorway.

narration.text: የውጤት ቀን አባቴ ፈገግ ብሎ አቀፈኝ፤ የመጨረሻው ምዕራፍ ቀልድ አይወድም አለኝ።
narration.subtitle: On results day, my father smiled and hugged me; he said: the final chapter does not like jokes.

shots.purpose: Direct call to action to the viewer to start preparing tonight.

keyframe.prompt: Close-up shot of an open clean notebook sitting on a dark wooden study desk at night under warm glowing lamp light, inviting atmosphere, dark blurred room background, centred composition

motion.prompt: Slow zoom-out from the illuminated open book on the dark wooden table.

narration.text: የ12ኛ ክፍልም ሆነ የመውጫ ፈተና፣ ጊዜው አልረፈደም። የእናንተ የመጨረሻ ምዕራፍ ዛሬ ማታ ይጀምራል።
narration.subtitle: Grade 12 or exit exam, it is not too late. Your final chapter starts tonight.

end_card.text: Made with AI (Gemini, FLUX.2, Wan 2.2, ACE-Step). Words from my father.
